answer: Modern Maison Co offers catering, charcuterie classes, kids’ cooking sessions, boards and grazing options.

title: Current classes and workshops

Our class categories include Charcuterie Workshops, Kids’ Cooking Classes, and Senior Classes. We offer a fully mobile characuterie workshop/classes, meaning we bring the entire expeirence to your home/airbnb/location of choice! All supplies are included. answer: We offer a variety of Charcuterie boxes, ranging from our Individual Charcuterie Boxes ($25) and requiring a minimum order of 10, to other boxes that start at $90, serve 3 to 4 people, and are custom made. Orders must be placed 72 hours in advance, and delivery fee may vary based on location.

title: Delivery radius and fees
questions: Do you deliver to Detroit?
How far do you deliver?
Is my address in your delivery area?
What's the delivery fee?
Do you deliver to Royal Oak or Ferndale?
answer: We offer delivery within approximately 20 miles of Detroit. Delivery is $30 within this range, with a $200 minimum order required. We may travel up to 30 minutes from Detroit for larger orders or events. For smaller orders, we typically stay within a 20-mile radius. Areas include Detroit, Royal Oak, Warren, Sterling Heights, Ferndale, Troy, Birmingham, Bloomfield, Dearborn, Farmington, Southfield, and more. For exact availability, we recommend confirming with your zip code.

questions: How early do I need to book?
Can I place a last minute order?
How much notice do you need for an order?
When should I book for a wedding?

answer: All orders must be placed at least 72 hours in advance. For large catering events, weddings, or custom experiences, we recommend booking even earlier to secure your desired date.

answer: Our catering services require a minimum of 30 people. This allows us to provide the full Modern Maison experience with proper setup and presentation.

title: Cancellation policy
questions: What's your cancellation policy?
Can I get a refund if I cancel?

answer: Cancellations within 10 days of your event will receive 75% of the deposit back, while 25% is retained as a non-refundable fee. No refunds are available for other completed or fulfilled orders.

answer: We offer a variety of dietary accommodations including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, pork-free, halal, and pescatarian options. While we do our best to accommodate allergies, we cannot guarantee a completely cross-contamination-free environment.
